name: Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Must first secure employment in Saint Kitts and Nevis before a work visa/permit application can proceed.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from an employer in the Federation.

requirements.blocker_text: Application (with gathered supporting documents) must be submitted to the appropriate consulate or immigration authority.

sources.title: Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis -- In SKN Work Visa Procurement: 3-step process (secure employment, gather documents, submit to appropriate consulate); no labour-market-test, fee, or duration detail published

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. The official gov.kn page is thin -- no fee, processing time, labour-market-test, or permit duration was found; process appears to run through employer sponsorship and consulate submission rather than a domestic labour-market-test system like Trinidad and Tobago's or the BOTs'. pr_after_months (36) is an estimate carried over from the general Permanent Residency 'under-62' route's 3-year lawful-residence figure (see kn_permanent_residence.json) rather than a confirmed work-permit-specific rule -- flagged as an inference, not a sourced fact.
